content.comment_body: I set up a custom site with a homepage and an additional page, linking it to the navigation menu in the [company_name] web server software. When accessing the site via Google Chrome and Firefox, the homepage and project I/O display correctly, but the navigation menu bar is missing, preventing access to the secondary page. Microsoft Edge is the only browser where the side menu bar appears and works properly. I have updated Chrome, enabled JavaScript, cleared cache, reinstalled Chrome, and tried a different computer, but none of these steps resolved the issue. I provided a test project with screenshots showing the missing menu in Chrome and its presence in Edge. Has anyone else encountered this, and is there a solution? Thank you, [user_name]

Hello [user_name], Please avoid posting the same issue multiple times. You created another topic yesterday regarding the problem: 'Extended website Navigator Page not visible on home page using Chrome.'

Thread closed since the question was posted twice. The second thread with the subject 'Extended website Navigator Page not visible on home page using Chrome' is published under the [company_name] - Communication conference. Best regards, [user_name]_Moderator

analysis.insight_summary: A user reports that the navigation menu bar on a custom webpage created in [company_name] web server software does not appear in Chrome or Firefox, while it works correctly in Microsoft Edge. This issue impacts access to additional site pages, and remains unresolved despite steps like browser updates, cache clearing, reinstalling browsers, and trying alternative PCs. This suggests a compatibility issue between the web server interface and certain web browsers.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the navigation menu to consistently display and function across all major browsers when accessing their [company_name]-based web server.
